Rich.Panel.signature: Panel(renderable, box=Box(ROUNDED), *, title=None, title_align='center', subtitle=None, subtitle_align='center', safe_box=None, expand=True, style='none', border_style='none', width=None, height=None, padding=(0, 1), highlight=False)
Rich.Panel.description: A console renderable that draws a border around its contents.[reference:35]

renderable.description: The content to be displayed inside the panel (text, table, or any Rich renderable).[reference:36]

box.description: A Box instance that defines the look of the border (e.g., ROUNDED, HEAVY, ASCII).[reference:37]

title.description: Optional title displayed in the panel header.[reference:38]

title_align.description: Alignment of the title (left, center, or right).[reference:39]

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle displayed in the panel footer.[reference:40]

safe_box.description: If True, disables box characters that don't display on legacy Windows terminals with raster fonts.[reference:42]

expand.description: If True, the panel stretches to fill the console width. If False, it sizes to fit the content.[reference:43]

style.description: The style of the panel (border and contents).[reference:44]

border_style.description: The style of the border specifically.[reference:45]

width.description: Optional fixed width of the panel in characters. Defaults to auto-detection.[reference:46]

height.description: Optional fixed height of the panel in lines. Defaults to auto-detection.[reference:47]

padding.description: Optional padding around the renderable inside the panel.[reference:48]

highlight.description: If True, enables automatic highlighting of the panel title (if it's a string).[reference:49]

fit.signature: fit(renderable, box=Box(ROUNDED), *, title=None, title_align='center', subtitle=None, subtitle_align='center', safe_box=None, style='none', border_style='none', width=None, height=None, padding=(0, 1), highlight=False)
fit.description: An alternative constructor that sets expand=False, making the panel fit its content.[reference:50]
